scope: Post-timeout-adapted comparison of complete maintenance decisions on four known historical inputs. The unchanged baseline and one fixed lossless raw-transcript-suffix presentation share the transcript, empty inventory, capacity and decision rules; required selections are not supplied.

source.worktree_note: The opt-in timing module, bridge, transport, related tests and evaluation documents were uncommitted. The frozen runner and candidate were session-only.
source.fixation: Original prompt and transcript bytes, inherited semantic definitions, new execution method and fresh masking commitment were bound in private evidence before inference. This is not a publicly timestamped preregistration.
source.documentation_note: This sanitized result is a post-unmask addition; no historical source, answer, rubric, authorization or sealed rating is changed.

authorization.scope_note: The additional-paid-inference approval did not restate an amount. Independent prospective review accepted contextual incorporation of the pending one-attempt, 400000000000-nano-AIU postpaid proposal, not reuse of old permission or unused balance.

usage.arithmetic: Exact original numeric lexemes with decimal integer arithmetic, preserving fractional nano-AIU. Cost, tokens and request counters use the requested-model family; API duration uses root totalApiDurationMs. Duplicate root/model/agent families are not added.

masked_assessment.counting_note: The mechanical-failure row has no semantic arrays. Atom, proposal and claim counts are coverage of the seven valid outputs, not independent trials or additional quality units.
masked_assessment.consistency_correction: One assessor-written claim description and its rationale were corrected from a bare requests array to an object containing only that array. The proposal, rubric, support verdict and all overall verdicts were unchanged; both tables are retained.
masked_assessment.prior_exposure_disclosure: Before outputs and fresh map generation, the replacement assessor read the first 80 lines of the original rubric and stopped on historical role/binding metadata. Independent prospective review accepted this as task/source awareness, not demonstrated recognition of an opaque output's condition. The historical assessor was unavailable and was replaced before output exposure.
masked_assessment.masking_limit: The assessor accepted the unchanged semantic projection and full procedure. No condition map, actual call order, timing, usage, parent quality expectation or historical answers were supplied. Declared masking does not prove absence of all prior knowledge; task-blindness and all-component independence are not claimed.
masked_assessment.grading_limit: Semantic support is the named assessor's judgment under the fixed rubric, not independent human adjudication. The parent validated bindings, coverage schema and aggregation, without regrading or post-unmask repair.

engineering_screen.eligible_field_meaning: Technical, accounting and masking prerequisites are satisfied; this does not mean the all-four-quality-pairs prerequisite for the efficiency screen is satisfied.
engineering_screen.reason: The candidate met the 4/4 retention floor with no baseline-only supported pair. The baseline's mechanical failure leaves only three both-supported pairs. The frozen rule requires all four and returns INCONCLUSIVE; no favorable-subset efficiency calculation or adoption is permitted.

terminal_evidence.closure_limit: Recorded registered local process closure and exact-owned guest absence do not prove closure of unregistered or provider-side work.
terminal_evidence.privacy: Sanitized counts, slot measurements, mapped outcomes and evidence hashes only. No raw answers, prompts, reasoning streams, opaque-ID map or seed, credentials, host paths, PIDs or unrelated inventories are released.
terminal_evidence.hash_scope: Hashes identify retained private evidence, not public access or trusted external timestamps.

limitations: Four known, correlated historical inputs, one output per condition/input, and a source-aware model assessor do not establish population reliability or general superiority from the observed 4/4 versus 3/4.

The policy was adapted after a timeout and used CLI 1.0.90 rather than 1.0.89. Changed runtime and stochastic responses prevent attributing completion to the longer deadline or declaring the historical timeout remedied.
Reported usage was higher for the candidate across all four calls. This is descriptive accounting, not an eligible quality-matched efficiency result.
All eight original-invoke transports completed below 300 seconds. The deadline is not a physical termination or whole-experiment bound.
The historical v4/v5 development studies still did not reach later memory-eligible work. This maintenance comparison does not establish development-memory usefulness or production M5 acceptance.
No extra semantic grader, post-unmask rating repair, model retry, automatic candidate adoption or further paid attempt is authorized.
